messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: AHM2 out very soon now !
parts:
Dear all,

it's with huge pleasure and no small relief that we can finally announce the imminent publication of AHM2 (Applied hierarchical modeling in ecology, volume 2); see the front and back covers of the book in the attachment. This book, along with volume 1 (AHM1 published in 2016), is intended to be a gentle and applied introduction to, and a comprehensive overview of, most of the types of models that we are talking about in the HMecology and the unmarked lists. In particular, both the AHM1 and the AHM2 book are sort of like the official books on population and species distribution modeling using unmarked. We hope that both books have been, and will be, useful.

Best regards  -- Marc & Andy

In particular, both the AHM1 and the AHM2 book are sort of like the official books on population and species distribution modeling using unmarked. We hope that both books have been, and will be, useful.

 

Best regards  -- Marc & Andy
